pdf_script = '''
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from docx import Document
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Extract all paragraphs
paragraphs_text = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if text:
        style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""
        paragraphs_text.append((text, style_name))

# Build PDF
pdf_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
pdf_doc = SimpleDocTemplate(pdf_path, pagesize=letter,
                            leftMargin=0.75*inch, rightMargin=0.75*inch,
                            topMargin=0.75*inch, bottomMargin=0.75*inch)

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
title_style = ParagraphStyle("CustomTitle", parent=styles["Title"], fontSize=16, spaceAfter=12)
heading_style = ParagraphStyle("CustomHeading", parent=styles["Heading2"], fontSize=13, spaceAfter=8)
body_style = ParagraphStyle("CustomBody", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=10, spaceAfter=6, leading=14)

flowables = []
for text, style_name in paragraphs_text:
    # Escape XML special chars for reportlab
    safe = text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">")
    if "Title" in style_name or "title" in style_name:
        flowables.append(Paragraph(safe, title_style))
    elif "Heading" in style_name or "heading" in style_name or "Subtitle" in style_name:
        flowables.append(Paragraph(safe, heading_style))
    else:
        flowables.append(Paragraph(safe, body_style))
    flowables.append(Spacer(1, 4))

pdf_doc.build(flowables)
print(f"PDF created successfully at {pdf_path}")
'''
